summary: Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (pricing, create+GET for all plans/tiers, server-side totals, validation 400/422, 404s, id not _id). Frontend (390x844): all required testIDs present; sticky CTA scrolls to widget; widget totals correct (270/300/370/925/1850); checkout -> validation errors, stepper clamps (1-10 one_time, 1-4 subscribe), pay-method switching, clinic_name only on clinic, Enter submits, orders placed for one_time/clinic/subscribe -> /order/[id] confirmation with correct order-number/total, reload persists, back-home works. Accordions (single-open) and footer anchor links work. Issues: before/after slider cannot be dragged with a mouse on web (touch drag works), invalid order id shows a spinner for ~8s, and the before/after photos don't show scars. PAYMENT IS MOCKED (mock_paid). Deprecated packages detected: none.

minor.issue: order_number is built from count_documents()+1. Two orders placed at the same time can get the same number, and there is no unique index. Use an atomic counter (find_one_and_update $inc) or a unique index.

ui_bugs.issue: Dragging with a mouse moves the handle only about 6-12px. RCA: expo-image renders an that the browser drags natively. 'dragstart' fires on the IMG and the pointer-move stream stops. Even with dragstart prevented, the handle still barely moved. Tapping to set the position works, and CDP touch drag works (moved 120px correctly). Fix: set pointerEvents='none' / draggable=false on both images (wrap them in a View with pointerEvents='none'), or use react-native-gesture-handler Pan.

/order/<invalid id> shows the spinner for ~8s because React Query retries the 404 three times. The error state also has no way back home (dead end). Set retry:false (or skip retries on 404) and add a back-home button.

issues: The before/after images are two unrelated Unsplash skin photos with different skin tones and textures (the after photo shows water droplets). Neither shows a scar, so the comparison is unconvincing for a scar product. Use matched scar photos of the same subject, or clearly labelled illustrations.
The NTU tile subtitle is cut off as 'Nanyang Technological ...' at 390px width.
The 'Clinic & Multi-Pack' tab label almost touches the tab edge at 390px width.

Naming is inconsistent: checkout shows 'BioRNA-C · One-time purchase', while the confirmation shows 'BioRNA-C · Single Box' (from the backend plan_name). Same for 'Continuous Scar Care · Subscribe & Save' vs 'Continuous Scar Care Subscription'.
The greeting uses only the first word of the name ('Thank you, TEST.'). Fine for real names, but noted.

action_items: Fix BeforeAfterSlider mouse drag on web: stop native drag (pointerEvents none / draggable false on the images) and make sure the PanResponder move events keep coming with a mouse.
Order page: turn off React Query retries for 404 and add a back-home button to the error state.
Replace the before/after images with relevant, matched scar imagery.
Make order_number generation atomic (counter collection with $inc) and add a unique index.
Optional: make plan names consistent between the frontend and the backend plan_name; fix the truncated NTU trust tile text.
critical_code_review_comments: Pricing is defined twice, in the frontend PRICING (src/content) and the backend PLANS. The backend is the source of truth for totals, which is correct, but the two can drift. Consider using GET /api/pricing.

BeforeAfterSlider: onStartShouldSetPanResponder always returns true and onPanResponderTerminationRequest returns false. On native, a vertical scroll that starts on the slider will be blocked. Consider onStartShouldSetPanResponder: () => false and claiming only on horizontal movement.
Checkout fetch has no timeout or offline handling. Errors are shown through checkout-submit-error, which is fine.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed orders in db.orders through the tests (not cleaned up, because there is no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. Backend URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Run: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_orders.py. On web, the sticky CTA covers the bottom ~110px, so scroll elements to the center before clicking. Test slider dragging with CDP touch events and with a mouse.
rca_of_issue: Slider mouse drag: document 'dragstart' fired on IMG during mouse down+move (confirmed by a listener). Native HTML5 image drag takes over the pointer events, so PanResponder only gets the first move. Touch input is not affected.
